note: Both sets struggle with reading values from the charts, resulting in numerous incorrect claims. However, Set A is slightly better as it correctly captures the rated Generator Power (15 MW) and Gen. Torque (20 MN-m) in Region 3, whereas Set B incorrectly states these are reached at 10 m/s. Set B also includes some wildly inaccurate readings, such as a Rotor Thrust of 19 MN (actual peak is ~2.8 MN) and Generator Power of 4 MW at 3 m/s (actual is ~0 MW).
